verdict.rationale: The pack lists first-party docs for Bits AI, Datadog's AI assistant, alongside Incident Management, Monitors and Watchdog. That implies AI assistance exists in the incident and alert workflow, but none of the cited content describes generating incident summaries or alert context for responders. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated incident summaries, AI-generated alert/monitor context for responders, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
